content: BraiAnDetect stores all detection parameters in a BraiAn.yaml file in the QuPath project directory (or its parent). The main batch script is compute_classify_overlap_export_exclude_detections.groovy, which reads the YAML and applies all parameters. Additional utility scripts: find_threshold.groovy (histogram-based threshold suggestion) and run_script_for_multiple_projects.groovy (cross-project batch runner). Detection uses QuPath WatershedCellDetection on the DAPI channel; TdTomato measured in a cytoplasmic expansion ring; Fos classified on nuclear compartment. The assumed deployment model is one brain per QuPath project, with all sections as entries in that project.
